page_title: FRE 3-2 HOL | Freiburg v Holstein Kiel 11/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Dominik Javorcek (Holstein Kiel) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
90+5' This is a yellow card! Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+5' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90+1' Noah Atubolu pulls off a great save to deny Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' 3 - 2 Goal! Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:2.
90' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) serves up a nice cross, but Timon Weiner punches the ball away.
88' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the middle of the goal, but Noah Atubolu is alert and makes a decent save.

87' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards the bottom right corner from a promising distance, but Noah Atubolu denies him.
86' A lofted pass picks out Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender.
85' 3 - 1 Goal! Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 3:1.
85' He should have scored! Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
83' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) for Max Rosenfelder.
83' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Lukas Kubler and he is replaced by Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg).
81' Marcel Rapp prepares a substitution. Alexander Bernhardsson is replaced by Dominik Javorcek (Holstein Kiel).
80' Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
79' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Soren Storks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
77' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar.
76' That's the end of the game for Eren Dinkci, who is replaced by Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg).
76' The attendance is 33700.
76' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

74' 3 - 0 Ritsu Doan produces a sweet pass and picks out Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 3:0!

73' The cross into the penalty area from Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.

71' Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Soren Storks with no other option than to blow for a foul.
70' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Holstein Kiel was in an offside position.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Merlin Rohl leaves the pitch and Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) comes on.
69' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) replaces Lucas Holer.
68' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Timon Weiner has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
66' Marcel Rapp decides to make a substitution. Lasse Rosenboom will be replaced by Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel).
66' That will be all from Shuto Machino who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Andu Yobel Kelati (Holstein Kiel).
64' 10:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
62' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.
62' Freiburg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

62' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. The referee blows his whistle, Freiburg are awarded a corner kick.
61' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Merlin Rohl (Freiburg). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
58' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) was quite harsh and Soren Storks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
57' It's time for a substitution. Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) comes on in place of Armin Gigovic.
55' Freiburg fail to score from a corner as Timon Weiner (Holstein Kiel) leaps to collect the ball.

55' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Timon Weiner makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! The linesman makes the right call and Freiburg will have a corner.
53' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
51' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
48' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
48' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) brings his opponent down. Soren Storks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
45+1' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends it out of play. The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Freiburg. An attempted cross from Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) is cleared.
44' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
42' Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
38' 2 - 0 What a sweet shot! Christian Gunter (Freiburg) strikes the ball from the resulting free kick and proves his quality. His shot bounces in off the crossbar.
37' Soren Storks shows a yellow card to Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) for his blatant foul.
37' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

37' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one. Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick.
36' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Soren Storks blows for a foul. Freiburg get a free kick.
34' One of the players from Holstein Kiel times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
32' Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
31' Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
29' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Timon Weiner.
29' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
27' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Noah Atubolu, who smothers the ball.
26' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) commits a rough foul. Soren Storks stops the game and makes a call.
24' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it.

23' 1 - 0 Eren Dinkci produces a promising pass and it looks like Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) is going to clear it to safety. Oh, no! Instead of averting the danger, he sends the ball behind his own goalkeeper and alters the score to 1:0.
21' Freiburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
21' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Timon Weiner intercepts the ball. Freiburg will take a corner kick.
20' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
20' The corner by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
19' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball is out of play and Freiburg manage to earn a corner.
19' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
17' The ratio of the ball possession is 66:34.
15' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg. Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
14' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
14' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Timon Weiner comes off the line to clear the ball away.
13' Noah Atubolu is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Timo Becker (Holstein Kiel). Easy save!
12' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
10' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes high over the bar.
7' Timon Weiner is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Matthias Ginter (Freiburg). Easy save!
5' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
4' The ball is cleared after Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
3' Freiburg string together a series of short passes.
1' A cross from a corner kick by Holstein Kiel is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
